## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # IJagged arrays
//
// The standalone noun for ragged row data, for callers that have no domain type
// of their own to project onto the IJagged interface.

// A standalone list of variable-length rows in CSR form: the concrete carrier
// of the IJagged packing (invariant stated once on the `IJagged` interface in
// `collections.concepts.plato`). Builders such as FromRows return this
// type, and a domain type that HAS ragged rows holds one as a field
// (PolygonMesh3D.Faces); only a type whose own storage already names the rows
// differently (the adjacency tables) implements IJagged directly instead.
type JaggedArray<T>
    implements IValue, IJagged<T>
{
    Offsets: Array<Integer>;
    Values: Array<T>;
}
```
